title: Use Higgsfield’s open-sourced Seedance project prompts/assets as templates by…
content: Use Higgsfield’s open-sourced Seedance project prompts/assets as templates by copying their public prompts and reusing/modifying their ~1000 assets and ~100 AI-generated locations for your own film workflow.
tips: Use Higgsfield’s open-sourced Seedance project prompts/assets as templates by copying their public prompts and reusing/modifying their ~1000 assets and ~100 AI-generated locations for your own film workflow.

es.content:

Ahora es 100% de código abierto en Higgsfield: todos los prompts y assets son públicos.
